part: ATGM336H-5N71 (maker's name ATGM336H-5N-71: GPS/QZSS + BDS + GLONASS)

variants_stocked.part: ATGM336H-5NR32 (different chip AT6558R; VCC 1.8-3.6 V; pins 16/17 are I2C SDA/SCL instead of UART1; same footprint)

package: LCC-18 castellated module 10.1 x 9.7 mm, pad pitch 1.1 mm (manual p6-7)
kicad_symbol_note: none for ATGM336H. RF_GPS:MAX-M8Q (u-blox MAX) has the same outline but differs on pins 5 (EXTINT vs ON/OFF), 7 (VCC_IO vs reserved/float), 13, 15-18: do not reuse; draw from the pin table.
kicad_footprint: RF_GPS:ublox_MAX (exists: 18 pads, pitch 1.1 mm, pad centres +-4.75 mm, pads 1.8 x 0.8 mm). Same 10.1 x 9.7 mm 18-pad outline as the manual's land pattern (p7: pitch 1.1, pad 0.8 high, 9.7 between pad rows); compare the pad length with the p7 drawing before use.

pins.name: TXD0
pins.connect: main UART out -> GPS_TXD (brain LPUART2_RX, DISP_B2_11)

pins.name: RXD0
pins.connect: main UART in <- GPS_RXD (brain LPUART2_TX, DISP_B2_10)

pins.name: 1PPS
pins.connect: second pulse, rising edge aligned to UTC -> divider -> GPS_PPS (EMC_B2_18, 1.8 V pad)

pins.name: ON/OFF
pins.connect: module shutdown, active low -> port expander (or leave open if the rail is switched)

pins.name: VBAT
pins.connect: RTC + SRAM backup 1.5-3.6 V, 10 uA: always-on 3.0 V rail

pins.name: VCC
pins.connect: 2.7-3.6 V, 25 mA typ, 100 mA peak; 10 uF

pins.name: nRESET
pins.connect: active low; float if unused, or port expander

pins.name: VCC_RF
pins.connect: 3.3 V out for an active antenna (50 mA short-circuit limit, open detect below 2.5 mA); feeds RF_IN through 47 nH; unused with a passive antenna + own LNA

pins.name: TXD1
pins.connect: auxiliary UART out; leave open or test point

pins_source: ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p7-8

circuit.source: ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p11

circuit.value: 3 V cell in the maker's drawing; here the always-on 3.0 V rail (1.5-3.6 V, 10 uA)
circuit.source: ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p9, p11
ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p11 section 2.7.1 (active antenna gain 15-30 dB recommended)

circuit.value: AT2659 L1-band LNA: gain 21.5 dB, NF 0.8 dB, 4.3 mA, 1.4-3.6 V, SHDN high = on (logic high >= 1.1 V, low <= 0.4 V), 50 ohm output match inside; pins 1,2 GND, 3 RFIN, 4 VDD, 5 SHDN, 6 RFOUT
circuit.source: ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p11 section 2.7.2 ('with a passive antenna add an LNA stage'); AT2659 datasheet (src/G_at2659.pdf) p1-3

circuit.value: 6.8 nH input matching inductor, series into RFIN
circuit.source: AT2659 datasheet (src/G_at2659.pdf) p3 table 2; ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p11

circuit.value: DC block: 470 pF (AT2659 datasheet) / 100 pF (module manual drawing)
circuit.source: AT2659 datasheet (src/G_at2659.pdf) p3; ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p11
AT2659 datasheet (src/G_at2659.pdf) p3; ATGM336H-5N user manual (src/G_atgm336h_5n71.pdf = JLCPCB copy for C2940946, Chinese) p11

circuit.ref-role: FL_SAW (my addition, not in the maker's circuit)
circuit.value: 1575.42 MHz SAW filter ahead of the LNA, because this board has five transmitters; costs about 1.6 dB of noise figure
circuit.source: engineering suggestion; SAW datasheet src/G_saw_saffb.pdf downloaded, not studied

circuit.value: 3.2 x 1.6 x 1.1 mm ceramic chip antenna, 1559-1606 MHz, gain 1/1.8/1.4 dBi min, efficiency >= 50/68/60 %, linear; ground cleared under it 4.00 x 4.25 mm; maker's test board 80 x 37 mm with the antenna at the centre of a long edge; shunt 2.2 pF on the feed in the maker's layout (tune on the real board)
circuit.source: Pulse W3011 datasheet (src/G_w3011.pdf) p1-2, p4-5, p9

circuit.value: 10 x 3 x 1.47 mm chip antenna, 1575 MHz, 4.3 dBi peak (datasheet is one page with no layout guidance)

supplies.VCC: 2.7-3.6 V (3.3 typ); 25 mA typ / 30 mA max continuous at 3.3 V; peak 100 mA excluding antenna (manual p9)
supplies.sleep: no standby figure in the manual: use ON/OFF (pin 5, active low) or switch the rail and keep VBAT for hot start
supplies.ripple: use a low-ripple LDO, < 50 mVpp (manual p12)

logic.levels: VIL 0.2*VCC, VIH 0.7*VCC, VOL 0.4 V, VOH VCC-0.4 V at 12 mA (manual p9): 3.3 V logic at VCC = 3.3 V, not 1.8 V
logic.uart: 4800-115200 baud, default 9600, 8N1, NMEA 0183 + maker's CASIC binary (manual p10)
logic.pps: 1PPS rising edge aligned to UTC (manual p4); width/accuracy not given
logic.reset: nRESET active low, float when unused (manual p8)

to_brain: 1PPS -> resistor divider 3.3 V to 1.8 V -> GPS_PPS (EMC_B2_18 QTIMER3_TIMER1)
to_expander: AT2659 SHDN (or tie to the module's switched supply)

antenna.type: module accepts active (bias from VCC_RF via 47 nH, 15-30 dB gain) or passive antennas; for a passive antenna the maker asks for an external LNA (AT2659) although the -5N variants are listed with a front SAW and an LNA inside (manual p2 table)
antenna.feed: 50 ohm, antenna port close to RF_IN (manual p12)
antenna.sharing: not described; keep GNSS on its own antenna
antenna.antenna_detect: the module reports ANTENNA OPEN/SHORT/OK over NMEA $GPTXT; with a passive antenna it always reports OPEN (manual p12)

notes: JLCPCB's datasheet for C2940946 is the family manual (ATGM336H-5N); sub-variant columns on p2 (read from the rendered page): -11 GPS, -21 BDS, -31 GPS+BDS, -51 GPS+GLONASS, -71 GPS+BDS+GLONASS; all have 2.7-3.6 V supply, UART0+UART1, flash, TCXO, antenna detect and over-current protection, front SAW, LNA.
KiCad footprint for the antenna exists: RF_Antenna:Pulse_W3011.
A 25 x 25 or 18 x 18 x 4 mm ceramic patch (Kinghelm KH-GPS252504-WY C962216 stock 109, KH-GPS181804-WY C962215 stock 78) would receive better but is 4 mm tall and under 300 in stock.
pin_plan_conflicts: None on the UART and PPS pads. ON/OFF and nRESET are not in the plan (expander lines needed).
GPS_PPS divider: module VOH is VCC-0.4 = 2.9 V min, so the divider to the 1.8 V pad is required as the plan says.
